provenance: 24 authored fictional VOX tickets; no customer data

tickets.title: Production deploy fails with exit code 137
tickets.body: Our production deploy started failing after we raised the worker count. The build log ends with exit code 137. Customers cannot access the new release.

tickets.title: Locked out after enabling SSO
tickets.body: We enabled SSO this morning and the entire team is now locked out. Our launch starts in two hours. Can you help restore access?

tickets.title: Webhook deliveries returning 429
tickets.body: Webhook retries are building up and some requests return 429. We have 2,400 pending events and our order processing is delayed.

tickets.title: Invoice has a duplicate line item
tickets.body: The latest invoice shows the same seat adjustment twice. Could you explain the two line items before our finance team pays it?

tickets.title: How do I rotate an API key?
tickets.body: We are updating our security practices. Where can I find the recommended process to rotate an API key without downtime?

tickets.title: Build hangs while installing dependencies
tickets.body: Our preview build sits at installing dependencies for over 20 minutes. This started after updating the lockfile.

tickets.title: Team invitations are not arriving
tickets.body: Three new teammates have not received their invite emails. They checked spam. The invitations were sent about an hour ago.

tickets.title: Need an export of last month’s invoices
tickets.body: Could you point me to the monthly invoice download? I need PDF copies for our accounting records.

tickets.title: Database connection pool exhausted
tickets.body: Our app reports too many connections during peak traffic. The production service is returning intermittent 500 responses.

tickets.title: Custom domain still shows pending
tickets.body: We added the CNAME yesterday but the domain is still pending verification. Our DNS provider says it has propagated.

tickets.title: Where can I change the billing contact?
tickets.body: Our finance lead has changed. I would like future invoices to go to the new billing contact. What is the process?

tickets.title: Request for pagination example
tickets.body: The list endpoint works well. Is there a TypeScript example of cursor pagination for a larger collection?

tickets.title: Password reset link has expired
tickets.body: The reset link says expired even when opened immediately. I have tried requesting another email twice.

tickets.title: Scheduled jobs missed their last run
tickets.body: Two nightly jobs did not run and our reports have not updated. The schedule is configured for UTC.

tickets.title: Move a project to another team
tickets.body: We are reorganizing our projects. Can I transfer a project to a different workspace without rebuilding it?

tickets.title: Unexpected increase in usage
tickets.body: Usage rose after our release on Friday. Can you help us understand which resources are responsible?

tickets.title: Preview environment has stale variables
tickets.body: The preview deployment is using the old environment variable even though I saved the new value.

tickets.title: Add a read-only teammate
tickets.body: I want to invite a contractor who can view logs but cannot make changes. Which role should I choose?

tickets.title: Document the API rate limits
tickets.body: Where are the per-minute API rate limits documented? We are planning a bulk import next week.

tickets.title: Intermittent SSL handshake errors
tickets.body: Some users report an SSL handshake error on our custom domain. It started after changing DNS this morning.

tickets.title: Change the default deployment region
tickets.body: Our customers are mostly in Europe. How do we move the service closer to them?

tickets.title: Question about prorated seats
tickets.body: We added two teammates mid-month. How are those seats prorated in the next billing period?

tickets.title: Trouble using the CLI on Windows
tickets.body: The authentication command opens the browser but the CLI keeps waiting. I am using Windows and PowerShell.

tickets.title: Cannot remove an old team member
tickets.body: A former team member still appears in the workspace. The remove button is disabled for my role.

deployment.title: Deployment troubleshooting
deployment.content: Review the deploy logs and the most recent configuration change. Exit code 137 commonly indicates a process was killed, often due to memory pressure. Check memory metrics before changing instance size. Rebuild after environment changes.

access.title: Authentication troubleshooting
access.content: Check the configured connection, callback URL, role permissions and the identity provider logs. Ask a workspace administrator to review access. Never bypass SSO or change entitlements on the user’s behalf.

incident.title: Service troubleshooting
incident.content: Check service health, logs, error timestamps and resource metrics. For rate limits, inspect Retry-After and use exponential backoff. For database connections, review connection pool limits. Confirm the root cause before recommending a production change.

billing.title: Billing and invoices
billing.content: Check the billing dashboard and compare the service dates, seat count and prorated adjustments. A billing administrator can download invoices. Billing discrepancies need manual confirmation before any refund or account change.

docs.title: Developer documentation
docs.content: Locate the relevant section of the official documentation and verify the project settings. Ask for the CLI version or a minimal reproducible example if the specific error is unclear. Never share API keys in a support thread.
